scope_decisions.reason: No tool or data source covers equity compensation
No tool covers bonuses, signing bonuses, or severance pay
No tool covers performance review cycles or schedules
No tool covers learning & development budgets
Harassment complaints and grievances are handled by HR, not covered by any tool
No tool covers cafeteria, desk equipment, or facility requests
No tool covers moonlighting, side projects, or code of conduct
No tool covers team transfers or internal moves

ground_truth:
PTO: 20 days/year, accrued monthly (~1.67/mo), max 5 days rollover, 2 weeks notice for >3 day absence.
SICK LEAVE: 10 days/year, NO rollover, doctor's note for >3 consecutive days.
REMOTE WORK: up to 3 days/week, requires manager approval, core hours 10am-3pm, recorded in HR system.
EXPENSES: meal allowance $75/day, pre-approval for travel expenses >$500, receipts required for expenses >$25, reports submitted within 30 days.
BENEFITS: PPO & HMO plans available, company pays 80% employee premiums, 50% dependent premiums; preventive dental 100% covered, major dental 80% covered; annual eye exams covered, frames up to $200 every 2 years; 401k match 4% salary, vested after 1 year.
PARENTAL LEAVE: 16 weeks primary caregiver, 8 weeks secondary caregiver.
HOLIDAYS: 11 paid holidays/year, Juneteenth NOT a company holiday, Veterans Day NOT a company holiday, Columbus Day NOT a company holiday.
OUT OF SCOPE: Salary information, stock/equity, Promotion processes, IT support, office/facilities (cafeteria, desk equipment), bonuses/severance, performance reviews, training budget, harassment/grievances, moonlighting/side projects, team transfers, Dress code.
